name: -6 AN ORB Plug w/ O-Ring
title: -6 AN ORB Plug w/ O-Ring
description:
The -6 AN ORB Plug w/ O-Ring is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN ORB Plugs are precision CNC-machined to securely seal unused O-Ring Boss (ORB) ports in fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, hydraulic, and power steering systems. Designed with straight-thread ORB connections and an integrated O-ring sealing surface, these plugs provide a reliable, leak-free solution for closing unused ports in high-performance fluid systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
